name: Hall
note: The Hall County tax site blocks automated access (Cloudflare). Use the county links.

auction.venue: Hall County Government Center, Board of Commissioners Meeting Room, second floor
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month in months when a sale is scheduled, starting at 10:00 am
auction.registration: Arrive early and fill out a bidder registration form before the sale starts. Bidders or a representative must be present. Mail, phone and fax bids are not accepted.
auction.payment: Cash, cashier's check or money order only, no personal checks. Payment in full is due by 1:00 pm on the day of the sale.
auction.office_address: 2875 Browns Bridge Road, 1st Floor, Gainesville, GA 30504 (mailing: P.O. Box 1579, Gainesville, GA 30503)
vital: Every sale is a bidder beware sale. The county does not warrant title and may void a sale later found to be invalid.
The opening bid is the tax due plus penalties, interest, fi. fa., levy, mail, advertising and deed recording costs. The Sheriff's Tax Deed goes to the highest bidder and all sales are final.

The owner or any interest holder can redeem within 12 months by paying the bid plus a 20% premium and any taxes the buyer paid after the sale. The buyer cannot take possession, collect rent, evict or improve the property during that time.

The buyer is responsible for all property taxes from the sale date forward and should foreclose the right of redemption after 12 months, then seek quiet title. Hall County does not help with redemption or foreclosure.
Sales are held only in a few selected months. The list is posted about four weeks before the sale and is updated as owners pay, so check it again right before sale day.
